name: Taishan Mansion
description: Once, people who sought the path of the adepti had to pass the trials of heaven and earth. Taishan Mansion served as the trial of "earth." Now that the adepti have long departed from this realm, Taishan Mansion has also turned into a common treasure trove.

tabs.name: Domain of Mastery: Altar of Flames I
tabs.description:
A massive amount of Pyro energy is coursing through this scorching ancient sacrificial altar.
You will get scorched by merely being here.
You shall earn Talent level-up materials, if — and only if — you can pass the trial.
